task.title: Inspect exact recurrence occurrence history
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/969 to expose complete typed lifecycle evidence for one exact persisted recurrence occurrence.
acceptance_criteria: Return revision-bearing persistence, claim, release, and materialization events in stream order or None for an absent coordinate.
Validate present occurrence and aggregate evidence through canonical strict projection before returning history.
Fail closed on selected corruption while isolating unrelated streams and retaining read-only authority.

attempts.diagnostic: The initial contract test failed to compile because RecurrenceOccurrenceHistoryEvent and RecurrenceStore::occurrence_history did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added focused integration coverage for complete lifecycle, absence, corruption, post-cancellation evidence, and read-only behavior.

attempts.summary: Implemented and refactored the bounded slice.
attempts.diagnostic: Implemented revision-bearing typed history over canonical occurrence projection and reused the projected occurrence instead of introducing a second lifecycle state machine.
attempts.patch: Implemented issue 969 in crates/vela-kernel/src/scheduler.rs with focused tests and ADR-0085.

attempts.diagnostic: Independent review found that an absent coordinate could incorrectly fail on malformed aggregate evidence.
attempts.patch: Decided exact occurrence absence before authoritative definition replay while preserving strict validation for every present history.

attempts.diagnostic: A rate-limited false green was excluded; after cooldown, genuine CodeRabbit review raised one trivial suggestion to add explicit orphaned-occurrence-stream coverage and no blocking findings.
attempts.patch: Deferred the non-blocking coverage suggestion, preserved the verified head unchanged, and merged only after the substantive exact-head review and zero-thread checks passed.

outcome.summary: Issue 969 delivered exact occurrence history with strict selected-evidence validation, absence semantics, and bounded read-only authority.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 970 exact head

lessons: Exact absence should be decided from the selected occurrence stream before unrelated aggregate corruption can turn absence into failure.
Present lifecycle history must reuse canonical strict projection rather than drift into a permissive second replay path.

Substantive review suggested explicit orphaned-occurrence-stream coverage; the verified implementation already fails closed when occurrence evidence lacks its definition, so the non-blocking test-only suggestion was deferred.
History inspection grants no mutation, migration, generation, discovery, clock, dispatch, retry, or execution authority.
